title: What MTB Tire
description: Web app for finding the best mountain bike tire for your riding style, terrain and bike type.
why: I ride MTB, and picking tires is confusing for everyone, so I wanted to build a small app that helps with the decision using AI models. It was also a good reason to learn Cloudflare Workers and D1.
learned: Learned how to turn fuzzy rider input (terrain, riding style, bike) into a scoring model using AI that gives sensible recommendations.
